extra_vocab.en: a book that has many recipes and cooking instructions
extra_vocab.note: 多益常出現在書店、出版、餐飲與行銷情境，指收錄很多道菜做法的書。通常和 chef、publisher、bookstore 一起出現。

example.en: The shop displays several cookbooks near the front entrance.
example.zh: 這家店把幾本食譜書陳列在入口附近。

example.en: The chef plans to write a cookbook next year.
example.zh: 這位主廚打算明年寫一本食譜書。

example.en: We stock a vegetarian cookbook for customers who avoid meat.
example.zh: 我們備有素食食譜書，給不吃肉的顧客。

example.en: The cookbook author will sign copies at the bookstore on Friday.
example.zh: 這位食譜書作者星期五會在書店簽書。

examples.en: She gave her team a cookbook as a holiday gift.
examples.zh: 她送給團隊一本食譜書當作節日禮物。

examples.en: The store ordered fifty copies of the new cookbook.
examples.zh: 這家店訂了五十本新的食譜書。

examples.en: Our publisher will launch the cookbook at the food fair in May.
examples.zh: 我們的出版社會在五月的美食展上推出這本食譜書。

confusable.diff: recipe 是一道菜的做法；cookbook 是收錄很多 recipe 的書。

example.en: Please email me the recipe for the soup we had at lunch.
example.zh: 請把我們午餐喝的那道湯的食譜寄給我。

similar.diff: 意思幾乎相同，recipe book 說法較直白，cookbook 更常見。

example.en: Our company printed a recipe book for the charity event.
example.zh: 我們公司為慈善活動印了一本食譜書。

example.en: This recipe takes only twenty minutes to prepare.
example.zh: 這道食譜只需要二十分鐘準備。

example.en: The chef changes the menu every season.
example.zh: 主廚每一季都會更換菜單。

example.en: Please check the menu before you place the order.
example.zh: 下單之前請先看一下菜單。

extra_vocab.en: a group of goods sent to a buyer or a store
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於物流、倉儲與貿易情境，指一批交給運送方的貨物，語氣正式。另一個常見用法是 on consignment（寄售）。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 「寄售」要用 on consignment，介系詞用 on，前面不加 a 或 the。

example.en: Two consignments were sent to our Taipei warehouse today.
example.zh: 今天有兩批託運貨物送到我們的台北倉庫。

example.en: A large consignment of goods will be shipped next week.
example.zh: 一大批貨物將在下週出貨。

example.en: The store takes new products on consignment from small suppliers.
example.zh: 這家店向小型供應商以寄售方式進新產品。

example.en: Attach the consignment note to the box before pickup.
example.zh: 取貨前請把託運單貼在箱子上。

examples.en: The consignment of electronics arrived at the port on Monday.
examples.zh: 這批電子產品星期一抵達港口。

examples.en: Please check the consignment against the packing list before signing.
examples.zh: 簽收前，請先對照裝箱單檢查這批貨。

examples.en: Customs delayed the consignment because some documents were missing.
examples.zh: 因為缺少一些文件，海關延誤了這批貨。

confusable.diff: 拼法相近，但 assignment 是被指派的工作或作業，和貨物無關。

example.en: Our manager gave me a new assignment this morning.
example.zh: 我們經理今天早上給了我一項新任務。

similar.diff: delivery 是送貨這個動作或送到的貨；consignment 較正式，強調交給運送方的一批貨。

example.en: The delivery will reach your office before noon tomorrow.
example.zh: 貨品明天中午前會送到你的辦公室。

example.en: The shipment left the factory yesterday afternoon.
example.zh: 這批貨昨天下午從工廠出發了。

example.en: The plane carries cargo to three Asian cities.
example.zh: 這架飛機把貨物運往三個亞洲城市。

example.en: Air freight costs more than sea freight.
example.zh: 空運貨運費比海運貴。

derived.link: consign 是動詞，加 -ment 變成名詞，像 pay → payment、ship → shipment

senses.en: a group of goods sent together to a place

example.en: Our supplier sent a consignment of fabric to the Taipei factory.
example.zh: 我們的供應商把一批布料送到台北工廠。

senses.en: a way of selling in which the shop pays the owner after the goods are sold
senses.distinguish: 前面有 on 或旁邊有 shop、gallery、unsold 等字時，通常指寄售。

example.en: The gallery returns unsold paintings if they were left on consignment.
example.zh: 寄售的畫作若沒賣出，畫廊會退還。

extra_vocab.en: happening one after another without a break
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於財報、排程與獎項情境，如 three consecutive quarters。強調「一個接著一個」，語氣正式。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: consecutive 後面接複數名詞，如 three consecutive days，不能寫 three consecutive day。

example.en: The office will be closed for two consecutive days.
example.zh: 辦公室將連續休息兩天。

example.en: She won the sales award for three consecutive years.
example.zh: 她連續三年拿到業績獎。

example.en: Profits fell for the third consecutive month this spring.
example.zh: 今年春天利潤已連續第三個月下滑。

examples.en: Our online sales have increased for four consecutive quarters.
examples.zh: 我們的網路銷售已連續四季成長。

examples.en: The training will run for five consecutive days next week.
examples.zh: 這項培訓下週將連續進行五天。

examples.en: This is the second consecutive meeting that he has missed.
examples.zh: 這是他連續第二次缺席會議。

examples.en: The factory has operated without an accident for five consecutive years.
examples.zh: 這間工廠已連續五年沒有發生意外。

confusable.diff: continuous 是「不間斷地持續」；consecutive 是「一個接著一個、中間有分段」。
confusable.usage: consecutive 常接複數名詞或序數，如 three consecutive days；continuous 常接不可數名詞，如 continuous improvement。

example.en: The machine needs continuous power to run all day.
example.zh: 這台機器需要不間斷的電力才能整天運轉。

similar.diff: 較口語，放在數字和名詞之後，如 three days in a row。

example.en: The team won five games in a row this season.
example.zh: 這支隊伍本季連贏了五場比賽。

similar.diff: 較正式，強調一個接著一個，不一定是每天或每期都連著。

example.en: Three successive managers failed to fix the problem.
example.zh: 連續三任經理都沒能解決這個問題。

example.en: Please follow the sequence of steps in the manual.
example.zh: 請依照手冊上的步驟順序操作。

example.en: We will hold a series of workshops this month.
example.zh: 我們這個月會舉辦一系列工作坊。

derived.link: consecutive + -ly，形容詞變副詞，像 quick → quickly、recent → recently

extra_vocab.en: in many cases or by many people
extra_vocab.note: 多益常出現在 commonly used、commonly known 這類說法，用在產品說明、公告與報告中，語氣中性偏正式。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: commonly 常放在過去分詞前，如 commonly used；一般動詞前、be 動詞後也可以。

example.en: The form is commonly used for travel requests.
example.zh: 這份表格普遍用於出差申請。

example.en: We posted the most commonly asked questions on our website.
example.zh: 我們把最常被問到的問題貼在網站上。

example.en: The device is commonly known as a power bank.
example.zh: 這種裝置一般稱為行動電源。

examples.en: This software is commonly used by small companies.
examples.zh: 這套軟體普遍被小公司使用。

examples.en: Customers commonly ask about our return policy at the front desk.
examples.zh: 顧客常在櫃台詢問我們的退貨政策。

examples.en: Job interviews are commonly held on weekday mornings.
examples.zh: 面試通常安排在平日早上。

examples.en: This type of error is commonly found in new reports.
examples.zh: 這類錯誤常見於新的報告中。

similar.diff: usually 指某人或某處多半的習慣；commonly 指許多人或許多情況都這樣。

example.en: Our store usually opens at nine in the morning.
example.zh: 我們的店通常早上九點開門。

similar.diff: generally 是「大致上」，commonly 強調「普遍、常見」。

example.en: Prices are generally lower in the off season.
example.zh: 淡季的價格大致上比較低。

example.en: Our team often meets on Monday mornings.
example.zh: 我們的團隊常在星期一早上開會。

example.en: A typical project typically takes about three months.
example.zh: 一個一般的專案通常需要約三個月。

derived.link: 最基本的字；common + -ly 變成副詞，像 quick → quickly

extra_vocab.en: a famous person, especially in entertainment or sports
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於廣告、行銷與活動情境，如請名人代言或邀請名人出席。是可數名詞，指「人」。

example.en: Many celebrities attended the opening of the new hotel.
example.zh: 許多名人出席了新飯店的開幕。

example.en: A celebrity endorsement helped boost sales of our new sneakers.
example.zh: 名人代言協助提升了我們新款球鞋的銷量。

example.en: The celebrity chef will open a restaurant downtown next month.
example.zh: 這位名廚下個月將在市中心開一家餐廳。

example.en: A celebrity guest will speak at the charity dinner.
example.zh: 一位名人嘉賓將在慈善晚宴上致詞。

examples.en: The company hired a celebrity to promote its new phone.
examples.zh: 公司請了一位名人來宣傳它的新手機。

examples.en: The magazine published an interview with a local celebrity.
examples.zh: 這本雜誌刊出了對一位本地名人的專訪。

examples.en: Several celebrities will walk the red carpet at the launch party.
examples.zh: 幾位名人將在發表派對上走紅毯。

confusable.diff: 拼法相近；celebration 是慶祝活動，celebrity 是有名的人。

example.en: We held a small celebration for the new office.
example.zh: 我們為新辦公室辦了一場小小的慶祝會。

similar.diff: star 較口語，也可指某個領域特別傑出的人。

example.en: She is a rising star in the fashion industry.
example.zh: 她是時尚界的一顆新星。

similar.diff: 較正式，也包含政治人物等，不一定是演藝圈。

example.en: The mayor is a well-known public figure in our city.
example.zh: 市長是我們城市中廣為人知的公眾人物。

example.en: The singer gained fame after her first album.
example.zh: 這位歌手在第一張專輯後成名。

example.en: The popularity of this product keeps growing every year.
example.zh: 這項產品的受歡迎程度逐年增加。

example.en: Our company has a good reputation for fast service.
example.zh: 我們公司以快速服務聞名。

derived.link: 同詞幹 celebr-，原意是「很多人一起慶祝、稱讚」
celebrate + -ion，動詞變名詞，像 decorate → decoration

extra_vocab.en: a person or company that makes software or builds new buildings
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於科技與房地產情境：software developer 是軟體開發人員，property developer 是建商。要看上下文判斷是哪一種。

example.en: Several developers joined the project team late last month.
example.zh: 幾位開發人員上個月底加入了專案團隊。

example.en: A software developer from our company will lead the workshop.
example.zh: 我們公司的一位軟體開發人員將帶領這場工作坊。

example.en: The property developer received approval to build new apartments.
example.zh: 這家房地產開發商取得了興建新公寓的許可。

example.en: We hired an app developer to improve our mobile site.
example.zh: 我們請了一位應用程式開發人員來改善行動網站。

examples.en: The developer fixed the software bug before the deadline.
examples.zh: 開發人員在截止日前修好了軟體的錯誤。

examples.en: We are looking for a web developer with two years' experience.
examples.zh: 我們在徵求有兩年經驗的網頁開發人員。

examples.en: The developer plans to build an office tower near the station.
examples.zh: 這家開發商計畫在車站附近蓋一棟辦公大樓。

examples.en: Our developers will present the new app at Monday's meeting.
examples.zh: 我們的開發人員會在星期一的會議上介紹新的應用程式。

confusable.diff: designer 負責外觀與設計；developer 負責把產品做出來（寫程式或建造）。

example.en: The designer chose new colors for our company logo.
example.zh: 設計師為我們公司的標誌選了新顏色。

similar.diff: programmer 專指寫程式的人；developer 範圍較廣，包含整個產品的開發。

example.en: The programmer wrote a short script to sort the data.
example.zh: 這位程式設計師寫了一小段程式來整理資料。

example.en: The engineer checked the system before the launch.
example.zh: 工程師在上線前檢查了系統。

example.en: The contractor will finish the repairs by next Friday.
example.zh: 承包商會在下週五前完成維修。

derived.link: 最基本的字；develop + -er，做事的人，像 teacher、worker
develop + -ment，動作的結果，像 pay → payment、move → movement

senses.en: a person who makes software or apps
senses.distinguish: 旁邊有 software、web、app、code 等字時，通常是這個意思。

example.en: The developer updated the app to fix the login problem.
example.zh: 開發人員更新了應用程式來修正登入問題。

senses.en: a company or person that builds new buildings on land
senses.distinguish: 旁邊有 property、land、housing、construction 等字時，通常是這個意思。

example.en: The developer sold all the new apartments within one month.
example.zh: 開發商在一個月內賣完了所有新公寓。

extra_vocab.en: to press the numbers on a phone to call someone
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於電話與辦公室情境，如 dial an extension、dial 9 for an outside line，也常出現在語音系統：Dial 1 for... 。當名詞時指刻度盤或旋鈕。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: dial 是及物動詞，直接接號碼，不加 to：dial 555-0123，不寫 dial to 555-0123。

example.en: She dials the front desk when guests need help.
example.zh: 客人需要協助時，她會撥打櫃台電話。

example.en: He dialed the wrong extension and reached the sales team.
example.zh: 他撥錯分機，打到了業務部。

example.en: Dialing the country code first is important for overseas calls.
example.zh: 打國際電話時，先撥國碼很重要。

example.en: Dial a number with the area code if you call another city.
example.zh: 打到其他城市時，請連同區碼撥號。

example.en: Dial an extension to reach the person you need.
example.zh: 請撥分機找你要找的人。

example.en: Staff abroad can dial in to the meeting by phone.
example.zh: 在國外的員工可以用電話撥入參加會議。

examples.en: Please dial the extension number of the sales department.
examples.zh: 請撥業務部的分機號碼。

examples.en: Dial 1 if you want to speak with customer service.
examples.zh: 如果想和客服人員通話，請按 1。

examples.en: To make an outside call from the office, dial nine first.
examples.zh: 要從辦公室打外線，請先撥九。

examples.en: Turn the dial to adjust the temperature of the oven.
examples.zh: 轉動旋鈕來調整烤箱的溫度。

confusable.diff: 拼法相近；dialogue 是兩人以上的對話，和撥電話無關。

example.en: The dialogue between the two managers was polite and clear.
example.zh: 兩位經理之間的對話禮貌又清楚。

similar.diff: call 泛指打電話；dial 只指按號碼撥出的動作。

example.en: Please call me when your flight lands.
example.zh: 你的班機降落時，請打電話給我。

example.en: Please turn off your phone during the meeting.
example.zh: 開會時請關掉你的手機。

example.en: My extension is 305 if you need me.
example.zh: 需要我的話，我的分機是 305。

example.en: Please dial 9 before the number for an outside line.
example.zh: 撥外線時，請先在號碼前按 9。

example.en: Turn the dial to the right to raise the volume.
example.zh: 把旋鈕往右轉來調高音量。

extra_vocab.en: a difference between two things that should be the same
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於帳務、報告與訂單核對，指兩份資料本來應該一致卻對不起來，語氣正式。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: discrepancy 後面常接 between A and B 或 in + 資料，不用 among。

example.en: The auditors found several discrepancies in last quarter's accounts.
example.zh: 稽核人員在上一季的帳目中發現幾處不一致。

collocations.phrase: a discrepancy between A and B
collocations.zh: A 和 B 之間的差異

example.en: There is a discrepancy between the two price lists.
example.zh: 這兩份價目表之間有出入。

example.en: The team worked all day to resolve the discrepancy.
example.zh: 團隊花了一整天來解決這個不一致的問題。

example.en: Any discrepancy in the figures must be reported to finance.
example.zh: 數字上若有任何出入，都必須通報財務部。

examples.en: The accountant found a discrepancy in the monthly expense report.
examples.zh: 會計人員在每月的費用報告中發現了不一致。

examples.en: We noticed a discrepancy between the invoice and the actual delivery.
examples.zh: 我們發現發票和實際送達的貨品有出入。

examples.en: Please explain this discrepancy before we send the report to clients.
examples.zh: 在我們把報告寄給客戶之前，請說明這個差異。

examples.en: A discrepancy in the dates delayed his travel approval.
examples.zh: 日期上的不一致延誤了他的出差核准。

similar.diff: difference 泛指任何不同；discrepancy 指本該一致卻不一致，語氣較正式。

example.en: There is a big difference between the two quotes.
example.zh: 這兩份報價之間有很大的差別。

similar.diff: inconsistency 強調前後矛盾、不一致，不一定是數字對不上。

example.en: We found an inconsistency in the customer data.
example.zh: 我們發現客戶資料有前後不一致的地方。

example.en: The system showed an error when I saved the file.
example.zh: 我存檔時，系統顯示了錯誤。

example.en: I made a mistake on the order form.
example.zh: 我在訂購單上填錯了。
